Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer extracted an incomplete birthplace from the English Wikipedia infobox, recording only “Okinawa, Japan” based on the visible viewport without verifying the full infobox. This omission (missing “Naha”) misled subsequent planning toward a less precise/incorrect birthplace. Later views showed the correct “Naha, Okinawa, Japan,” indicating the initial capture was incomplete or not fully verified.
